Chapter 197: Calamity Befallen On The Nine Saint Demon Gate (1)

Chapter 197: Calamity Befallen on the Nine Saint Demon Gate (1)

The Ancient Sky City was boiling up with countless existences readying their fists as even more coffins entered the city!

“I’m certain all the Earth Corpse will be scrambling for the Underworld Boats, that will be our best time to enter the burial ground for treasures!” Sects and cultivators who weren’t here to bury their predecessors were quickly preparing cautiously.

The ones who wanted to revive during the appearance of Underworld Boats were far from just dying cultivators but also the Earth Corpses, Treasure Lords, and even the Earth Immortals of the burial ground!

Once the Underworld Boats arrived, countless Earth Corpses will rush towards them. This was their best opportunity to live again for this was not only the chance at rebirth, but they will also be able to escape from the Heavenly Ancient Corpse Burial Ground. There would also be a few impatient Treasure Lords not minding the loss of millions years accumulation in lifespan just to come and seize the Underworld Boats. The same case applied to the Earth Immortals. However, their numbers were fewer than the Treasure Lords, because they already have a more promising rebirth chance due to their Dragon Veins!

So when all the Earth Corpses and Treasure Lords rushed for the Underworld Boats, all of the treasures inside the burial ground at that time were coveted by everyone.

Even though it was an extremely sinister place, but there were hoards of salivate-inducing treasures such as the treasure metals, godly ores, and sacred woods…

More importantly, too many people died at the burial ground, so it was understood that countless Life Treasures, technique scrolls, and godly items were left behind.

Even with the erosion of time causing many lost Life Treasures at the Heavenly Corpse Burial Ground to lose their divine awareness and turn into scrap metals, but those within three hundred to five hundred years are still usable. Dead cultivators’ Universe Pouch in this place could also contain unparalleled techniques. For the small sects and vagrant cultivators, unparalleled technique scrolls were far more alluring than Life Treasures.

Miracles like these had happened before. There had been vagrant juniors who risked their lives to enter the burial ground taking advantage of the Underworld Boat’s appearance and actually scavenged Emperor Laws. In the end, they became Virtuous Paragons and created their owns sect and legacies as great masters.

In fact, development like this happened in every era. This was another reason why the Underworld Boat’s appearance attracted an influx of cultivators to the burial ground. They knew that the risk of dying was extremely high here, upward of ninety percent, but still they could not fight the temptation and snuck into the burial ground in hope for an unparalleled technique or supremely divine weapons!

The group of Li Qiye was sitting at the seat of a mountain inside the burial ground with such a relaxed atmosphere. Unwary spectators would actually thought that they were just sightseeing beneath this cliff.

But in the end, this was the Heavenly Ancient Corpse Burial Ground. Anyone coming into this place especially in the Earth Immortals’ territories was especially alarmed. Even Virtuous Paragons were extremely meticulous with fear in such a location.

But Li Qiye was different. He sat there as if it was his own backyard in complete relaxation and complacent as if this was not the burial ground.

Seeing the contented Li Qiye made the group of Li Shuangyan relieved as they were also sitting there.

Sitting on a rock, Li Qiye’s legs swing back and forth enjoying the blowing cool breeze in utmost indulgence.

“This guy really knows how to pick a place. Buried in this place after death, truly a good decision.” Li Qiye couldn’t help but sentimentally speak.

It seemed as if Li Qiye and the man in the coffin was very familiar rendering the group in silence. But they felt like it was an impossible matter, their young noble was only fifteen, sixteen years old. In other cultivators’ eyes, he was only a little brat. Yet the old man inside the coffin hanging on the precipice must have been buried at this place for millions of years.

“Are we going to another place for treasures?” Eventually, Chen Baojiao asked. In fact, ever since they came inside, they had seen many treasure metals underground. However, the first time they came was for the transactions and the second time was for the honoring ceremonial so they couldn’t dig any treasures.

“No rush, wait until the Underworld Boats come out. If we dig treasures at this key moment, we will be ripped to shred!” Li Qiye shook his head and said.

Chen Baojiao nodded her head in agreement after listening. She was already very satisfied with her Tyrannical Immortal Saber and Heaven Traversing Eight Saber.

“Hey, are you not interested in coming out for the Underworld Boats? Maybe you will have a chance to leave this ghastly place.” Finally, Li Qiye slanted his head and shouted at the man inside the coffin.

The man inside the coffin was an invincible existence ah, other people who dared to talk to him like this would be courting their own death. In fact, Shi Gangdang’s group was wiping their sweats in place of Li Qiye! If the man inside the coffin became angry, he absolutely was capable of crushing everyone to death with just one hand.

However, the man remained silent and did not answer Li Qiye.

“If you are interested, I can give you a hand. The five hundred years spot is already taken by someone. If you want, I will give you a three hundred years spot? How about that?” Li Qiye smiled and spoke to the coffin.

Initially there was no answer, but after a long time, the wooden coffin opened and the man with a hole in his chest finally sat up. Even though his eyes were closed, he still stared at Li Qiye and said: “Are you the type to give out free lunch?”

“No! You should know, if we really want to discuss the matters, you still owe me a favor!” Li Qiye calmly replied: “But out of pity for your difficult time here, I am already a great person for not asking you to pay the favor!”

The group of Li Shuangyan became speechless. This was a bit too ridiculous ah. An existence buried for millions of year owed their young noble a favor? However, at this time they understood why this person protected them.

“I will give you three hundred years, and you will work for me for one hundred years, okay? This is a very good deal, much better than you laying here for millions of years.” Li Qiye smilingly said.

“Not good enough!” The man ultimately went back inside and closed his coffin lid!

Li Qiye could only shrug and added: “Really, you can do many things in just two hundred years. Of course, your wound is also very problematic.”

After a long moment of serenity, the coffin was opened again. The man sat up and asked Li Qiye: “Can I live for another era? If I can live for another era, you can name your price!”

“Are you joking ha!” Li Qiye then angrily answered: “Do you think I would still find you if I know how to live for another generation? I would rather keep it for myself, who doesn’t want to live for another generation? If I can live for another generation, I will absolutely reach eternality!”

“The old man from the War God Temple lived for another era!” The eyes closed man looked at Li Qiye.

“Haha, you are talking about the old fellow War God Mu. Li Qiye laughed “hek hek”, of course he was clear about this matter. Naturally, without his aid, War God Mu would definitely not have been able to give for another era.

At this point, the crowd of Li Shuangyan couldn’t help but to glance at Li Qiye. Living for another era, this was indeed a legend. Li Shuangyan was even more attentive, because she had heard her master Lun Ri talked about this. War God Mu of the War God Temple did indeed live for another era inside the Heavenly Ancient Corpse Burial Ground.

“Living for another era, this chance is too small. I’m afraid there won’t be another opportunity in this life.” He shook his head and continued on: “War God Mu being able to give for another era was merely a gamble, and he actually paid a huge price! In my opinion, wanting to live for another era in this generation, this chance is much smaller than wiping out all the Ancient Ming brats!”

“I can wait for the next generation!” Having heard this, the man stuck his head back inside the coffin.

“Haha, wait for the next generation?” Li Qiye chuckled and then responded: “With just you, I’m afraid you won’t be able to live for another era, so why bother caring if there is a chance in the next generation!”

Since the man in the coffin no longer said anything else. Li Qiye could only shrugged and murmured: “This personality of yours is still as stinky and hard as manure pit’s pebble.”

The group once again was scared out of their minds because of Li Qiye’s words provoking an invincible existence ah. But what confused them is that the man in the coffin didn’t bother to retort, let alone becoming angry, as if he didn’t hear what Li Qiye said.

“Hey, give us a ride, walking out is truly too troublesome.” At this point, Li Qiye turned his head towards the man in the coffin and shouted.

Such words made the group of Li Shuangan silent and Niu Fan was filled with embarrassment. This was an invincible existence ah, a preeminent sovereign ah, who did our young noble think he is? A carriage driver? Or a litter carrier?”

They were stunned in the moment for only their young nobles would dare to say such a thing to an invincible existence.

During their moment of absence, the man in the coffin held out his hand and lightly shot out a wave with his finger. A godly rainbow immediately appeared and stretched over the Heavenly Ancient Corpse Burial Ground all the way to its frontier.

At this point, the group of Li Shuangyan lost control of their bodies as they walked over to the godly rainbow and flew towards the burial ground’s frontier. This speed was too fast for they flew from the Earth Immortal’s Dragon Vein to the frontier in just a blink of an eye.

When they reached the frontier, the godly rainbow suddenly disappeared making the group fell down like potatoes tumbling on the ground.
